threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still ask for directions to the nearest tube, while everyone knows it’s a bus or a bike that gets you where you need to go.
Last night on the 59, a guy sat serenading everyone with his ukulele. Most just nodded off, but a couple joined in. Brixton magic, even at 3 AM.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I saw a guy in a full tuxedo pulling a wheeled suitcase of fresh bagels down Hermannstraße at 3 AM. That's Neukölln for you.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin can you find a club open at 7 AM on a Monday, filled with tired ravers who just can’t quit the weekend vibe. Totally unique energy.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s from here when they calmly mention a BART breakdown like it’s just another Tuesday morning. The visitors panic, but we’re already making plans to walk.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a Muni bus with a guy in a tuxedo arguing with a street performer over who’s the real star of the city. Only here, folks.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think every plaza is a party spot. Most locals avoid Plaça de la Vila de Gràcia after dark; it turns rowdy with street performers.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They’re the ones still using their cameras on the metro instead of just enjoying the ride. Noticed a lot of them trying to catch that perfect street shot.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You keep looking for the 30 bus stop but don’t realize it’s just a light on the corner; locals know it doesn't follow 'normal' routes.
Caught a bloke on the 37 last night singing opera to himself. Didn't even flinch when the driver glanced back. Classic Peckham moment.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: Hearing a spontaneous street concert in the courtyard while the smell of döner wafts in from across the street—only in Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find hidden courtyard bars where the drink menu changes daily based on what the bartender feels like mixing. Absolute gems!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: If they know the difference between a raspa and a snow cone, they're a local. Tourists just say 'ice treat' and look lost.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a full tuxedo on the 31 Balboa, sipping sparkling water. Only in SF do folks dress for a black-tie event and take the bus afterwards.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often think Gràcia is just a loud fiesta. They miss the quiet mornings where locals sip café con leche and chat about last night’s Barça game.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by the way they still walk into cafés expecting to find a table without a reservation during peak hours. Sweet naivety.
